title: Open measurement mechanism: coverage of the frozen provision corpus
statements: This report counts what the published data holds. Every number in it is derived by scripts/mechanism/build-coverage.mjs from committed files; none is typed.

A provision marked PREDICATE has a deterministic check whose result a stranger can re-run. It is a measurement of one observable the provision names, not a finding that anyone complies with or breaches it.
A provision marked RELATED_MEASURE is one that a measured board axis points to as relevant. The pointer is informative: the axis does not test the provision.

HASH_ONLY means the provision is in the frozen manifest as an identifier and a SHA-256, and nothing tests it. The source text bytes behind those hashes were not recovered, so the manifest is not an inspectable legal corpus.
Measurement, not certification. No compliance label, endorsement or regulator relationship is stated or implied.

hierarchy.label: Authority
hierarchy.means: Who makes or enforces the rule. Held as a source-and-routing record; a record is not a relationship with the authority and not a live regulator API.

hierarchy.label: Instrument
hierarchy.means: The law, framework or standard, named by its official identifier (CELEX for EU acts).

hierarchy.label: Version
hierarchy.means: Which text of the instrument was frozen. Today the manifest pins each provision by a SHA-256 of normalised text; the source bytes that produced those hashes were not recovered.

hierarchy.label: Provision
hierarchy.means: One addressable unit of the instrument (an article, or an id the manifest assigns), with its frozen hash.

hierarchy.label: Obligation
hierarchy.means: A single duty cut out of a provision, with its conditions. No obligation register exists yet.

hierarchy.label: Applicability
hierarchy.means: Whether the obligation applies to a given system. Not determined here: every authority record says applicability needs review by the party concerned.

hierarchy.label: Crosswalks
hierarchy.means: Rows elsewhere that map this instrument to another framework or to a measured axis.

hierarchy.label: Evidence requirement
hierarchy.means: What bytes a test needs to see. Stated per predicate below.

hierarchy.label: Test / profile
hierarchy.means: A deterministic predicate (PREDICATE) or a measured axis that points to the provision (RELATED_MEASURE).

hierarchy.label: Watcher
hierarchy.means: Something that polls the authority and expires the mapping when the text changes. Read from the manifest's own watcher field.

corpus.watcher: NOT BUILT — local corpus only; no authority is polled
corpus.limitation: The public manifest proves the 417 identifiers, their frozen hashes and their aggregate root. It does not include the exact normalized source-text bytes needed to regenerate each per-provision hash, and no authority watcher was active when it was frozen.

predicates.name: Article 50 marking evidence
predicates.scope: Paragraph 2 only: whether a generated file carries a machine-readable mark that named methods detect, at the time of the check.
predicates.deterministic: C2PA manifest-store presence, assertion hashes, the c2pa.hash.data hard binding and the COSE_Sign1 claim signature under the leaf's own key; IPTC DigitalSourceType read from XMP.
predicates.not_measured: C2PA chain trust (no trust list is bundled), SynthID and other keyed watermarks, the open-source DWT-DCT detector and text watermarks. The response lists each with its reason.
predicates.evidence_requirement: The file's bytes (an https URL we fetch, or the bytes posted), up to 20 MiB, or a C2PA manifest on its own.
predicates.result_wording: Results read "marking not detected by method X"; never absent, compliant or non-compliant.
predicates.binding_today: The check quotes the verbatim Article 50(2) text with its SHA-256. It does not yet cite the frozen provision id.

routes_today.name: Look up an endpoint
routes_today.how: Paste an MCP server, A2A agent or x402 endpoint URL at /verify-server/. It shows every published capsule about it and re-checks each one in your browser.
routes_today.is_not: It only shows what the public censuses already measured. It does not start a new measurement.

routes_today.name: Be in a public registry the censuses read
routes_today.how: The census capsules read public listings: MCP servers in the public registries the MCP census reads (contract parity, tool drift) and signed agent cards listed in the a2aregistry census. A listed endpoint is read when that census next runs.
routes_today.is_not: No date is promised, and being measured is not being endorsed.

routes_today.name: Article 50(2) marking check on one file
routes_today.how: GET /api/art50/marking-evidence?url=<https URL>&preview=1 runs the deterministic marking check on the file and returns the result unsigned.
routes_today.is: free preview, same measurement as the signed pack
routes_today.is_not: Not a legal opinion on Article 50. A signed pack is a separate commissioned route.

routes_today.name: Agents: the MCP server
routes_today.how: POST https://councilof.ai/mcp, tools measurement_index, verify_capsule and server_evidence.

routes_today.name: Contest a published result
routes_today.how: The dispute route re-runs the frozen instrument and publishes the re-run as a new signed record.
routes_today.is_not: An allegation is measured, not argued.

not_open_today.what: POST /api/evidence-intake, which would queue a candidate record for operator review.
not_open_today.why: It returns WRITER_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: no public writer is configured, so nothing submitted there is stored.

not_open_today.what: A form to submit an arbitrary written claim for measurement.
not_open_today.why: None exists. A claim is measured today only when it is one of the kinds an instrument above reads.
